Would it be possible to reopen and merge it? https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/2645 EIPIP meeting #20 in (1 hr.) Join Zoom Meeting https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88506535400?pwd=U3RmaGxYbEMzTDZuekxwNE0xbGNKZz09 Meeting ID: 885 0653 5400 Passcode: 729174 Is, "Micah is turning into a despot." on the agenda? (because Micah *is* turning into a despot due to having unchecked power) Self-regulation is a thing. A thing I don't have. 😬 A quick idea - one way to get more eyes on proposals would be to implement a more formal peer-review process. That is, the author and editors work to find appropriate reviewers for particular PRs. That spreads the load to more volunteers and helps ensure that appropriate experts take a look. I like anything that gets more people looking at EIPs and (hopefully) getting them improved more before I see them. In a world of fairies and ponies, by the time I (an editor) look at an EIP it is already pretty high quality and I just have to give it a quick once-over. > A quick idea - one way to get more eyes on proposals would be to implement a more formal peer-review process. That is, the author and editors work to find appropriate reviewers for particular PRs. That spreads the load to more volunteers and helps ensure that appropriate experts take a look. <@!683653554631868440> I briefly mentioned about this idea in the meeting today. I'd be happy to help with this process. <@!191378736254287874> mentioned getting some money for some paid/professional EIP editors. What are the chances of getting that? and thanks Pooja, for volunteering, that is always better. <@!396163506757435403> since it's very early in me exploring this it's entirely unclear. I actually would prefer not to be paid.
